highlights.description: **Cedar-based policy engine**: dependency PR quarantine/approval decisions are now evaluated against Cedar policy bundles, with structured decision outcomes and human-readable comment formatting

**GitHubCollector, GitHubMerger, GitHubReleaser, and the dependency graph Builder migrated off go-github onto `gogithub/clientv1.Client`**; `github.com/google/go-github` is now only a transitive dependency
**GitHub App and `GITHUB_TOKEN` authentication** for CI usage, plus structured logging via `omniobserve`

added.description: [policy] Cedar policy engine for evaluating dependency PRs
[policy] Cedar policies split into bundles by concern
[policy] Decision outcomes and enhanced `PolicyDecision`
[policy] Quarantine profile for the N+5 rule
[policy] Decision comment formatter
[cmd] `policy evaluate` CLI command
[collector] PR comment methods (create, update, find-by-marker)
[collector] go.mod diff analysis for dependency PRs
[collector] GitHub API rate limit handling
[observability] Structured logging via `omniobserve`
[ci] GitHub App and `GITHUB_TOKEN` authentication support
[deps] `cedar-go` v1.8.0 for policy evaluation

changed.description: [graph] Migrated the dependency graph `Builder` off go-github
[ci] Renamed docs workflow to match the reusable workflow

tests.description: Added comprehensive unit tests for core packages
Added tests for the Cedar engine and decision outcomes

documentation.description: Added an MkDocs site with Cedar policy documentation
Updated README with new policy features and UTF-8 feature icons
Switched MkDocs to the PlexusOne unified theme
Added a GitHub App creation guide, including a web UI option for adding secrets
Added JSON Schema and configuration documentation

Fixed CLI flag reference drift across `docs/commands/*.md` and `docs/configuration/cli.md`: removed fabricated flags/shorthands, added real ones, and corrected two examples showing a nonexistent `review --policy` flag (Cedar policies are only evaluated via `policy evaluate --policies`)

dependencies.description: Upgraded `github.com/grokify/gogithub` to v0.17.0 (from v0.13.0, via an intermediate v0.14.0 dependabot bump)
Bumped `actions/checkout` from v4 to v7 and `actions/setup-go` from v6 to v7

internal.description: Added MkDocs build output and `IDEATION_CHAT*.md` to .gitignore

go.mod parser with support for require, replace, and exclude directives

Topological sort for correct upgrade ordering

Caching layer with memory and file backends, TTL support
Rate limiting with automatic retry via `mogo/net/http/retryhttp`

Progress reporting for graph build operations

Policy-based auto-review and merge of Renovate/Dependabot PRs
